query: For a 42‑year‑old man with a postoperative ICU admission, among male inpatients aged 37–47, compute medication complexity over the first 72 hours, stratify into quintiles, and report LOS, in‑hospital mortality, and 30‑day readmission rates per quintile and estimate his risk.
final_sql: SELECT p.gender, p.anchor_age, p.anchor_year, p.anchor_year_group, a.admittime, a.dischtime, a.deathtime, a.los, i.icustay_id, i.intime, i.outtime, i.length_of_stay, m.medication_complexity, m.medication_complexity_rank, m.medication_complexity_rank_percentile, m.medication_complexity_rank_quintile, m.medication_complexity_rank_quintile_label, m.medication_complexity_rank_quintile_label_short, m.medication_complexity_rank_quintile_label_long, m.medication_complexity_rank_quintile_label_short_with_percentile, m.medication_complexity_rank_quintile_label_long_with_percentile, m.medication_complexity_rank_quintile_label_short_with_percentile_and_rank, m.medication_complexity_rank_quintile_label_long_with_percentile_and_rank, m.medication_complexity_rank_quintile_label_short_with_percentile_and_rank_and_los, m.medication_complexity_rank_quintile_label_long_with_percentile_and_rank_and_los, m.medication_complexity_rank_quintile_label_short_with_percentile_and_rank_and_los_and_icu_stay_length, m.medication_complexity_rank_quintile_label_long_with_percentile_and_rank_and_los_and_icu_stay_length, m.medication_complexity_rank_quintile_label_short_with_percentile_and_rank_and_los_and_icu_stay_length_and_death_date, m.medication_complexity_rank_quintile_label_long_with_percentile_and_rank_and_los_and_icu_stay_length_and_death_date, m.medication_complexity_rank_quintile_label_short_with_percentile_and_rank_and_los_and_icu_stay_length_and_death_date_and_30_day_readmission_rate, m.medication_complexity_rank_quintile_label_long_with_percentile_and_rank_and_los_and_icu_stay_length_and_death_date_and_30_day_readmission_rate, m.medication_complexity_rank_quintile_label_short_with_percentile_and_rank_and_los_and_icu_stay_length_and_death_date_and_30_day_readmission_rate_and_risk_score, m.medication_complexity_rank_quintile_label_long_with_percentile_and_rank_and_los_and_icu_stay_length_and_death_date_and_30_day_readmission_rate_and_risk_score FROM patients p JOIN admissions a ON p.subject_id = a.subject_id JOIN icustays i ON a.stay_id = i.stay_id JOIN medications m ON m.subject_id = p.subject_id AND m.hadm_id = a.hadm_id WHERE p.gender = 'M' AND p.anchor_age = 42 AND p.anchor_year = 2017 AND p.anchor_year_group = '37-47' AND a.admittime <= '2017-01-01' AND a.dischtime >= '2017-12-31' AND (a.deathtime IS NOT NULL OR i.outtime >= a.dischtime + interval '72 hours') AND (a.deathtime IS NULL OR i.outtime < a.deathtime + interval '72 hours') AND (a.deathtime IS NULL OR (a.deathtime + interval '72 hours') <= i.;
